body.statement: For each of the treated-mean, replicated-smoothing, random-spacing, and covariance-aligned donor channels, there are pairs \((P_{0,q},P_{1,q})\subset\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}(\lambda)\) with \(q\in\{\mathrm{tr},\mathrm{sm},\mathrm{sp},\mathrm{don}\}\) such that \(P_{\ell,q}(z_0\in\mathcal Z_+\mid E_0)\ge c_X\), the joint observed-data Kullback--Leibler divergence is bounded by a universal constant, and \(|\tau_{n,P_{1,q}}(z_0)-\tau_{n,P_{0,q}}(z_0)|^2\ge cR_q\) on \(\mathcal Z_+\). Every pair is induced by a regular conditional law of the complete causal panel rather than by a labeled fixed-query kernel.
body.justification: This is the missing bridge from conditional statistical experiments to an admissible causal panel converse.
body.gap: The banked predecessor supplied only labeled fixed-query witnesses and no panel-induced lower bound.
body.consumer: The sharp frontier can be cited as a result about causal panels rather than only about an auxiliary regression experiment.
